note: Fallback used when NBA.com player-dashboard endpoint is unavailable.

catch_shoot_source.source: NBA.com Players Catch & Shoot, 2025-26 regular season, totals
catch_shoot_source.join: one player-season row per player, name-normalized with 3 documented aliases

hustle.note: No NBA hustle row; player has 3 season minutes and is below the modeling threshold.

tracking_sources.normalization: Counting totals are retained and also expressed per 36 minutes. Ratios are recomputed from aggregated numerators and denominators where applicable.
